name: Kṛṣṇa (Vāsudeva)
summary: In BhG 10–12 he declares himself the unknown origin of gods and seers and names his manifestations, among them 'Vāsudeva among the Vṛṣṇis' (ch. 10); shows Arjuna his universal form by grace, declares himself Time, and states that he is seen only by undivided devotion (ch. 11); and answers which worshippers are most joined, giving graded means and the marks of the dear devotee (ch. 12). Addressed as Keśava, Janārdana, Hṛṣīkeśa, Acyuta, Viṣṇu, Hari, Yādava.

name: Arjuna (Pārtha, Dhanaṃjaya)
summary: In BhG 10–12 he acknowledges Kṛṣṇa as supreme brahman on the testimony of the seers and asks for his manifestations (10.12–18); asks to see and then sees the universal form, praises it, asks forgiveness for past familiarity and asks for the gentle form again (11.1–4, 11.15–46, 11.51); and asks which worshippers are the best knowers of yoga (12.1). The Lord names him 'Dhanañjaya among the Pāṇḍavas' (10.37).

name: Sañjaya
summary: Narrates to Dhṛtarāṣṭra the showing of the universal form (11.9–14), Arjuna's trembling homage (11.35) and Kṛṣṇa's resuming his gentle form (11.50).

name: Dhṛtarāṣṭra
summary: Addressed as 'O king' by Sañjaya (11.9); his sons are seen rushing into the mouths of the universal form (11.26).

name: Nārada
summary: Named by Arjuna, as the divine seer, among those who declare Kṛṣṇa the supreme brahman (10.13); 'of divine seers I am Nārada' (10.26).

name: Asita Devala
summary: Named by Arjuna among those who declare Kṛṣṇa the supreme brahman (10.13); 'asito devalaḥ' may also be read as two sages, Asita and Devala.

name: Vyāsa (Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana)
summary: Named by Arjuna among those who declare Kṛṣṇa the supreme brahman (10.13); 'of the munis I am Vyāsa' (10.37).

name: Bhṛgu Vāruṇi
summary: 'Of the great seers (maharṣi) I am Bhṛgu' (BhG 10.25).

name: Kapila
summary: 'Of the perfected (siddha), the sage Kapila' (BhG 10.26); the verse does not connect him with Sāṃkhya, which the commentators do.

name: Uśanas (Śukra)
summary: 'Of poet-seers (kavi) I am the poet Uśanas' (BhG 10.37).

name: Bṛhaspati
summary: 'Know me as the chief of household priests, Bṛhaspati' (BhG 10.24).

name: Rāma (Dāśarathi)
summary: 'Of weapon-bearers I am Rāma' (BhG 10.31); the verse does not specify which Rāma — the commentators generally take Dāśarathi Rāma.

name: Bhīṣma (Devavrata, Gāṅgeya)
summary: Seen by Arjuna entering the mouths of the universal form (11.26); named by Kṛṣṇa among the warriors already slain by him, whom Arjuna is to slay (11.34).

name: Droṇa
summary: Seen by Arjuna entering the mouths of the universal form (11.26); named by Kṛṣṇa among the warriors already slain by him (11.34).

name: Karṇa
summary: The 'son of the charioteer' (sūtaputra) seen entering the mouths of the universal form (11.26); named by Kṛṣṇa among the warriors already slain by him (11.34).

name: Jayadratha
summary: A warrior of the Kaurava side, named by Kṛṣṇa with Droṇa, Bhīṣma and Karṇa among those already slain by him whom Arjuna is to slay (BhG 11.34).
